When an orthogonal or diagonal line across the board is completely filled with tiles, the scoring is carried out, with players receiving points depending on total influence of their animals in the line. The special scoring case is when a completed line has exactly 10 influence. In this case only the player who placed the last tile earns the points. When the board is completely filled with tiles, the player with the highest score wins the game. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Overview 2 Board 3 Tiles 4 Gameplay 5 Game End 6 Game Variants 6.1 Mice 6.2 Team Game Overview Savanna Ten(サバンナテン) is an area majority game for 👤 2 players to 👤 4 players players. The 5x5 game board features a number of orthogonal and diagonal lines that are scored as soon as they're filled with animal tiles, with the player satisfying an influence condition receiving a number of points. Board The board consists of 20 spaces arranged in a 5x5 grid, with the remaining 5 spaces being inaccessible. There is a number of straight lines that can be formed on the board , including the ones that connect across the inaccessible spaces: ➡ 5 rows of 4 spaces ⬇ 5 columns of 4 spaces ↗ 2 diagonals of 4 spaces ↗ 8 diagonals of 3 spaces Each line is subject to being scored as soon as it's completed (all line's spaces filled with tiles). Tiles Each player is given a shuffled deck of tiles, each having a 🦁Lion on the back and another animal on the front, and draws two tiles into their hand . The deck and the hand is kept 🦁Lion side up, hidden from other players. Both sides of a tile feature an influence value , that corresponds to the amount of influence the tile contributes to any completed line it's a part of. Gameplay Each turn a player places one of the tiles from their hand in any empty space of the board. The tile can be placed either the 🦁Lion side or another animal side up. If this action completes one or more lines on the board, each of them gets scored as follows: 🔟➖: If the total influence of the line is less than 10 , the player(s) with the most total influence score 2 points 🔟➕: If the total influence of the line is more than 10 , the player(s) with the least total influence score 1 points 🔟⭐: If the total influence of the line is exactly 10 , the player who placed the last tile scores 3 points After placing a tile, a player draws another tile from the deck, if it's not yet empty. Game End The game ends when the board is completely filled with tiles , with the player having the highest score winning the game. Ties are resolved by having the lowest number of 🦁Lions on the board. Since in a 👤 3 players game the last player will have an extra tile left in their hand, they receive 2 points as a compensation. Game Variants Mice A 🐭Mouse is shuffled into each player's deck. Its influence is only 1, but adds 1 bonus point for its owner each time they score a line containing the 🐭Mouse. Team Game A 👤 4 players player game can be played in teams, with the first team using red and yellow tiles, and the second team blue and green ones. The players from a single team have common score , and when scoring a line both tile colors contribute to the team's total influence . In Savanna Ten, players compete to secure their hold on the Savanna. Players receive decks of animal tiles with different influence values, and take turns placing one of them on the board. All tiles have a Lion on the back, and can be placed both face up and face down.

Points are earned by completing lines of 3 or 4 animals of any ownership. The scoring is carried out as soon as each line is completed, and the way it's resolved depends on the total influence value of the line:


     If it's less than 10, the player with most influence scores 2 points.
     If it's more than 10, the player with least influence scores 1 point.
     If it's exactly 10, the player who completed the line scores 3 points.


The game ends when the board is completely filled, and the player with the highest score wins the game. The ties are broken by the lowest number of placed Lions.

[Rating: 7/10] In this short tile laying game, the goal is to gain the most points. Players have a stack of tiles, 4 on one side and various numbers on the other. On a player's turn, players will place their tile (either side) onto the board. Scoring occurs once any line is fully filled, where the sum represents how much points a player gains, with a sum of >10 the player with less influence gains 1 point, >10 the player with the most influence gains 2 points, and sum of 10 points gives the player that placed that tile 3points.
